title: What are MEP services?
desc:
MEP stands for Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing services. These services cover the essential systems that keep residential, commercial, and industrial properties safe, comfortable, and operational.
  • Air conditioning and ventilation
  • Electrical systems and wiring
  • Plumbing and drainage
  • Water pumps and water heaters
  • Preventive maintenance and repairs

title: What is included in MEP services in Dubai?
desc: MEP services in Dubai normally include inspection, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems. The exact service scope depends on the property, equipment condition, and maintenance contract.

title: Why is regular MEP maintenance important in Dubai?
desc: Dubai's hot climate places continuous demand on air-conditioning, ventilation, electrical, and water systems. Regular MEP maintenance helps identify developing problems, reduce unexpected breakdowns, improve system performance, and extend equipment life.

title: Which properties require MEP maintenance?
desc:
Professional MEP maintenance is suitable for almost every type of property in Dubai.
  • Villas and apartments
  • Residential buildings
  • Offices and retail shops
  • Restaurants and commercial kitchens
  • Hotels and holiday homes
  • Warehouses and industrial facilities
  • Schools and healthcare facilities

title: How often should MEP systems be serviced?
desc: The maintenance frequency depends on the type of system, its age, operating hours, manufacturer recommendations, and property usage. Frequently used systems may require monthly or quarterly checks, while other equipment can be inspected every six months or annually.

title: What is preventive MEP maintenance?
desc: Preventive MEP maintenance involves inspecting and servicing equipment before a breakdown occurs. It may include cleaning AC components, checking electrical connections, testing safety devices, inspecting plumbing systems, clearing drainage lines, and identifying leaks or worn parts.

title: What is an MEP Annual Maintenance Contract?
desc: An MEP Annual Maintenance Contract, commonly known as an AMC, provides scheduled preventive maintenance and breakdown support for covered systems. Depending on the selected package, an AMC may include AC servicing, electrical repairs, plumbing support, emergency callouts, and replacement of selected parts.

title: What are the benefits of an MEP maintenance contract?
desc:
An MEP maintenance contract helps property owners and businesses manage maintenance more efficiently.
  • Scheduled preventive maintenance
  • Priority breakdown support
  • Reduced risk of unexpected failures
  • Better equipment performance
  • Clear maintenance records
  • Improved budget planning

title: Does FAJ provide emergency MEP services in Dubai?
desc: Yes, FAJ Technical Services L.L.C provides emergency assistance for covered mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and air-conditioning problems. Service availability and response time may depend on the location, type of emergency, technician availability, and AMC package.

title: When should I request emergency MEP assistance?
desc:
Request urgent assistance when a fault creates a safety risk or may cause serious property damage.
  • Burning smells, sparks, or overheating electrical panels
  • Complete or repeated electrical failure
  • Burst pipes or major water leaks
  • Sewage overflow or severe drainage blockage
  • AC failure in a critical commercial area
  • Water pump or water supply failure

title: What should I do during an electrical or plumbing emergency?
desc: Keep people away from the affected area and switch off the relevant electrical supply or water valve only when it is safe to do so. Never touch wet electrical equipment, exposed wiring, or a damaged distribution board. Contact a qualified technician, building maintenance team, or emergency authority according to the severity of the situation.

title: What does an MEP inspection include?
desc: A typical MEP inspection may include checking AC performance, filters, coils, drainage, electrical panels, circuit breakers, sockets, lighting, water pressure, plumbing fixtures, pumps, water heaters, visible pipework, and signs of leakage or corrosion. A detailed inspection may also include testing and a written condition report.

title: How much do MEP services cost in Dubai?
desc: MEP service costs depend on the type of property, fault complexity, equipment capacity, required labour, spare parts, access conditions, and urgency. A technician may need to inspect the system before providing an accurate quotation. Always request a clear estimate explaining labour, materials, exclusions, and warranty terms.

title: Can MEP maintenance help reduce DEWA bills?
desc: Properly maintained systems may help reduce unnecessary electricity and water consumption. Cleaning AC components, correcting thermostat issues, repairing hidden water leaks, maintaining pumps, and fixing faulty electrical equipment can improve efficiency. Actual savings depend on the condition and usage of the property.

title: Can an MEP technician investigate a high DEWA bill?
desc: Yes. A sudden increase in electricity or water consumption may be linked to an inefficient AC system, continuously operating equipment, a defective water heater, a hidden leak, a faulty pump, or another internal problem. An MEP inspection can help identify possible causes, although billing and utility supply matters should be confirmed directly with DEWA.

title: How often should water tanks be cleaned in Dubai?
desc: Dubai Municipality advises residents to clean and disinfect water tanks and plumbing systems at least every six months using an approved company. The required frequency can vary according to the property type, water system condition, occupancy, and applicable health and safety requirements.

title: Can one MEP company handle AC, electrical, and plumbing work?
desc: Yes. A full-service MEP company can coordinate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing work through one maintenance team. This is particularly useful when a problem involves multiple systems, such as an AC water leak affecting electrical equipment or a faulty pump disrupting the building's water supply.

title: Are MEP services suitable for commercial properties?
desc: Yes. Commercial MEP services can support offices, restaurants, retail stores, warehouses, hotels, schools, clinics, and other facilities. Maintenance can be scheduled around business hours to reduce operational disruption and may include preventive maintenance reports and asset condition records.

title: Can an MEP company maintain fire alarms and life-safety systems?
desc: Some MEP companies support fire alarms, emergency lighting, pumps, and related safety equipment. However, regulated fire and life-safety work must be completed by appropriately approved and qualified contractors in accordance with Dubai Civil Defence requirements. Confirm the contractor's approval before authorising this work.

title: How do I choose the best MEP company in Dubai?
desc:
Choose an MEP service provider with experienced technicians, clear quotations, suitable trade licences, responsive customer support, proper safety procedures, and written service documentation.
  • Check the company's service experience
  • Confirm the scope of work
  • Request transparent pricing
  • Review warranty conditions
  • Ask about emergency support
  • Confirm regulatory approvals where required

title: Do MEP companies provide a service warranty?
desc: Many professional MEP companies provide a limited warranty for completed repairs and parts supplied by them. Warranty duration and coverage vary according to the service, equipment, and replacement part. Request the warranty conditions in writing before approving the work.

title: Who is responsible for MEP repairs, the tenant or landlord?
desc: Responsibility normally depends on the tenancy agreement, the cause of the fault, and the scale of the repair. Major equipment or building-system repairs are often handled by the property owner, while minor maintenance or damage caused by the tenant may be the tenant's responsibility. Review the lease agreement or consult the property manager.

title: Why should I avoid DIY electrical and MEP repairs?
desc: Incorrect repairs can cause electric shock, water damage, fire hazards, equipment failure, and more expensive repairs. Electrical panels, refrigerant systems, pumps, pressurised pipes, and safety equipment should only be handled by trained and suitably qualified technicians.
